researchMeta.scope: Eight Religious Zionism/Otzma Yehudit members; priority given to 2023-2026 recorded, consequential, absurd or visually meme-worthy material over generic policy language.
researchMeta.method: Hebrew exact-phrase, name-plus-event, date-bounded, publisher-specific and visual-event searches; primary or closest-primary recordings/posts preferred, with high-quality reporting used where the original post or broadcast was not stably inspectable.
researchMeta.evidenceRule: Exact quotations are never silently strengthened. Shortened text is marked shortened; paraphrases are marked paraphrase; visual moments are explicitly labeled nonquote documentary context or editorial metaphor.

crocsInvestigation.subject: Claim that Itamar Ben Gvir appeared publicly in Crocs
queries: "איתמר בן גביר" with כפכפים, קבקבים, נעלי גומי and סנדלים
"בן-גביר" Crocs; "Ben Gvir" Crocs shoes photo meme
site:x.com and site:twitter.com exact Hebrew name-plus-Crocs
Hebrew image/event searches for his Temple Mount visit, police-station disguise, private events and shoe-store video
crocsInvestigation.findings: No inspectable photograph, original social post, caption, article or event was found identifying Crocs on Ben Gvir. Search results repeatedly produced false positives for Trump gunman Thomas Matthew Crooks, retail product pages, or unrelated footwear references. A February 2026 TikTok/news item does document Ben Gvir trying on shoes in a Jerusalem store, but neither the article nor indexed video description identifies the shoes as Crocs.

quotes.originalText: Sometimes I pinch myself to make sure I am not in a dream, and then I remember my grandmother and I know — I am indeed in a dream, a dream that comes true.

quotes.sourceType: news report documenting the viral phonetic meme and its later use
quotes.context: At an Israel Bonds conference in Washington, Smotrich delivered an English speech containing a passage about remembering his grandmother. His pronunciation became the viral Hebrew meme 'גרנדמייזר'. The card deliberately prints the meme phonetically with an asterisk; it is not an exact transcript or a translation of the speech.
quotes.sourceLocation: Report body explains the phrase's origin in the Washington speech

quotes.flavor: A playful speech-bubble echo may turn the mispronunciation into the central visual beat.

quotes.sourceType: news verification linking archival Knesset Channel interview
